up: Retrieve the distinct ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES of compounds that have been tested in assays targeting the human D2 dopamine receptor (CHEMBL217). Ensure the target organism is Homo sapiens. Join the activities table with the assays table to filter by the target ID (tid corresponding to CHEMBL217) and organism. Join with the compound_structures table to retrieve the SMILES. Return only the chembl_id and canonical_smiles columns.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL217' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
